Author - Fachumonn (with Saint Asperes & Bisofeyr(i World Assembly Mission)

Proposal Link - https://www.nationstates.net/page=UN_view_proposal/id=fachumonn_1757181961

Cast your vote by reacting to this message. You can also discuss below. Information here may be used to construct an IFV.

:tep_for:  = FOR / AYE
:tep_against:  = AGAINST / NAY
:tep_abstain:  = TEP ABSTAINS
:tep_present:  = NO OPINION / PRESENT

Nay. The resolution might be flawed, but in light of the fact that there is seemingly no replacement coming after the repeal -- or that the author isn't proposing this with that idea in mind --  I can't support something that removes what little safeguards there are in place for migratory species. The resolution just nitpicks and mostly complains about wording or possible loopholes, but those are minor issues compared to the benefits of requiring cooperation, data sharing, and protections across the borders of WA member states.
I have to wonder why "no suitable replacement" Bisofeyr is on this
Changed the channel name: [NEXT] GA - Repeal "Protecting Migratory Animals"
My opinion's unchanged. This was clearly intended as the prelude to a nonexistent replacement
So much for resWA/cit voting reducing turnout. This is great
Changed the channel name: [AT VOTE - AGAINST] GA - Repeal "Protecting Migratory Animals"
Repeal "Protecting Migratory Animals" was passed 8,107 votes to 2,717 (74.9% support).
Changed the channel name: [PASSED] GA - Repeal "Protecting Migratory Animals"
